debrief.status_message_ar: المهمة نشطة: فهم القيد التشغيلي الإداري 100 ألف برميل على FIC-001 ودور التجاوز الإشرافي أثناء طفرات التدفق.
debrief.physical_cause_en: Without supervisor override, liquid accumulation in a cylindrical vessel accelerates near the top as chord width narrows.
debrief.design_lesson_en: LAHH trip automatically closes feed SDVs UZV-051/052 and gas SDV UZV-003 (UZ Group 15).

educational_review.learning_objective: Understand the administrative 100 kBOPD capacity cap on FIC-001 and the role of supervisor override during transient surges.
educational_review.key_takeaway: Without supervisor override, liquid accumulation in a cylindrical vessel accelerates near the top as chord width narrows.
